title: 更改负责人：队列选择器只读 sys_queue，应用包声明的队列选不到
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named site, filed by triage at repo:objectstack#3's request (mailbox #36743, comment 7119009171). Source: found by seat 3's ux-B dev on #36395, outside that card's surface.

## What happens

The Change Owner dialog's queue tab offers only `sys_queue` rows. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ChangeOwnerDialog.tsx:143` reads `adapter.find('sys_queue', { $top: 200 })` and nothing else (read on `origin/main`). ADR-0142 D1/D7 make queues that an app package declares first-class assignment targets. The other queue pickers build their candidates with `mergeQueueCandidates` (`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/queueCandidates.ts`, used by `RecipientPickerField`, `FlowReferenceField` and `refLabelDirectory`). So a queue that a package declares can be picked everywhere else, but not as a record's new owner.

reach: not measured. Which shipped packages declare queues was not read. The site was read from the code and was not run in a browser.

## Expected

The Change Owner queue tab offers the same candidates as the other queue pickers: `sys_queue` rows plus package-declared queues, merged the way `mergeQueueCandidates` merges them.

## Acceptance

- A pin in which a package-declared queue appears in the Change Owner queue tab and can be picked. The owner write then names that queue.
- A plain `sys_queue` row is still offered as today.

## Relation

This is the same query line as #36395 item 2 (the queue list caps at 200 with no search). #36395 is in flight with repo:objectstack#3, so this card is filed separately rather than folded in. The seat may land both in one PR.

Dedupe: open issues for `ChangeOwnerDialog` (#36395 only, the cap and search, not the candidate set), `mergeQueueCandidates` (none) and `change owner queue` (#36262, the server-side queue-target check, a different mechanism).
